title: incident-bot: on-call runbook quicklinks and SLO toolkit helpers
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds a small feature set to incident-bot that surfaces on-call runbook quicklinks in alerts and augments the SLO toolkit with helper utilities for scoring and prioritizing runbooks. Motivation: oncalls frequently need immediate access to contextually relevant runbooks and an SLO-aware ranking of suggested actions; this PR adds a lightweight quicklinks resolver and SLO toolkit helpers used by the incident-bot runbook suggester. Changes are backwards-compatible and gated behind feature flags. Includes unit and integration tests plus docs updates.
